description: Fetch paginated Amazon product reviews for one ASIN via Pangolinfo, with the upstream billing (pointCost) reported verbatim. Billing: docs and measured calls show 5 credits/page; the upstream tool description currently states 10 credits/page — this tool reports pointCost as returned, it does not assert a rate.

pageCount.description: Review pages to fetch (~10 reviews per page). Each page bills credits on the Pangolinfo account — see billing notes.

name: get_product_reviews
